name: Altech Corporation
summary: Altech Corporation provides total staffing services in Japan and internationally. The company offers staffing solutions, including assignment/contracting in technical/administrative fields; cultivating nursing care staff, assignment of nursing care staff, and introduction of nursing care facilities to residents; and education solutions, such as working professional training and technical training for new employees and mid-career employees.
